text: Three. What's this? That is for making boiled eggs. You're joking! What's wrong with just putting them in some water? I don't know. You forget to check the time when you put it on, and then you don't know how long it's been cooking, if it's hard or soft. Well... But with this, you just set the timer, and then it switches itself off when the egg's ready. You just stick the egg in there, press the button, and you're done! And you don't have to bother with water or pans or washing up or anything? Oh, come on! It's not that much trouble. You only normally have to rinse the pan quickly in some water. And dry it and put it back in the cupboard? Man, you're so lazy! No, it's like a toaster! And using this is more energy efficient than boiling eggs in water. And the egg never cracks. If you want to have the perfect boiled egg… I don't know. It just seems a waste of money to me. They should invent something really useful like a self-cleaning floor so you don't have to mop or vacuum.
